question: Cricketer Ravi Shastri represented the ________ team in the Ranji Trophy tournament.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravi Shastri**, a former Indian cricketer, represented the **Mumbai** team in the **Ranji Trophy**, which is India’s premier domestic cricket tournament.
 
• **Mumbai** has a rich history in Indian cricket and is considered one of the strongest teams in the Ranji Trophy, having won the tournament a record number of times.
 
• Ravi Shastri was known for his excellent all-round skills as a **batsman and bowler** during his playing career and played a significant role in Mumbai's domestic cricket success.
 
• He made his debut for Mumbai in the Ranji Trophy at a young age and went on to achieve great success, eventually becoming a key player for the Indian national team.
 
• Mumbai has produced numerous legendary cricketers, including **Sachin Tendulkar**, **Sunil Gavaskar**, and **Ajinkya Rahane**, who have also represented the team in the Ranji Trophy.
 
• The Ranji Trophy is named after **Kumar Shri Ranjitsinhji**, and it serves as the backbone of Indian domestic cricket, providing a platform for players to showcase their talent.

• **Karnataka**__
 __
 
• **Karnataka** is another successful team in the Ranji Trophy and has produced great cricketers such as **Rahul Dravid** and **Anil Kumble**.
 
• It is known for its strong cricketing infrastructure and has won multiple Ranji Trophy titles.
 
 
 
• **Delhi**__
 
 
• **Delhi** is a prominent team in the Ranji Trophy and has produced players like **Virat Kohli**, **Gautam Gambhir**, and **Shikhar Dhawan**.
 
• Delhi has a strong cricketing culture and has contributed significantly to Indian cricket.
